bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1,5,6 and 8. BRUTAL FORCE was a bit disappointing last start when a beaten favourite. He won his previous 2 starts on the heavy ground so from barrier 2 he can bounce back. LORD OF VALOR led throughout for a very easy win at Albury last start. From the good barrier and after the claim he can give a sight. HOT TODDY another one who draws well loves these conditions but this is a bit tougher today. BESSIE LA BELLE pulled up with issues last start and she drops in grade here. PERFECTLY GOOD also has some chance.

raceTips.comment: Hot Toddy has been racing in consistent fashion and looks well placed to continue that form after producing another encouraging effort at the latest outing. The gelding has enough early speed to settle on the pace and should prove difficult to run down if allowed to build momentum. Perfectly Good has been finding the line with purpose at recent appearances and looks suited by a genuine tempo that allows the finishing burst to come into play. Brass Monkeys has been holding form well and is capable of improving again with a smooth run throughout. Lang Park has shown enough ability to be competitive in this grade and should appreciate settling within striking distance before working into the race late. There is an in form jockey aboard Hot Toddy which is another positive.
